rules.notes: Registration renews annually (by March 31; $50 late fee after) without a CE requirement: Article XL sets no technician CE, and renewal CE (Article IV, License Renewal and Continuing Education) is set for pharmacists. The Board no longer requires PTCB certification for technicians.
rules.legal_basis: Miss. Admin. Code Title 30, Part 3001, Article XL § 2; Miss. Code Ann. § 73-21-111
rules.rule_quote: Each pharmacy technician shall renew his/her registration annually pursuant to Mississippi Code Annotated Section 73-21-111.
